description: This file contains functions for translating MAC layer PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) configurations into FAPI (FAPI is a standardized interface for 5G NR) PDU builder commands. It includes functions for filling in codewords, DMRS, frequency/time allocations, precoding, and CORESET configurations, specific to 3GPP 5G NR specifications.

methods.name: get_crb_interval
methods.description: Determines the CRB (Control Resource Block) interval based on the coreset configuration or bandwidth part configuration.

methods.name: fill_codewords
methods.description: Fills in codeword parameters into the FAPI PDU builder, supporting only one transport block.

methods.name: fill_codeword_information
methods.description: Sets codeword identification and reference point information.

methods.name: fill_dmrs
methods.description: Fills in DMRS (Demodulation Reference Signal) parameters.

methods.name: fill_frequency_allocation
methods.description: Configures frequency resource allocation in the PDU builder based on VRB to PRB mapping.

methods.name: fill_time_allocation
methods.description: Sets time domain resource allocation for PDSCH.

methods.name: fill_precoding_and_beamforming
methods.description: Configures precoding and beamforming parameters, supporting optional MAC info.

methods.name: fill_pdsch_information
methods.description: Fills basic PDSCH parameters including codewords, DMRS, time, and power info.

methods.name: fill_coreset
methods.description: Configures CORESET parameters based on trans_type and configuration.

methods.name: get_pdsch_trans_type
methods.description: Determines the PDSCH transmission type based on CORESET ID, search space, interleaving, DCI format, and configuration.

methods.name: get_vrb_to_prb_mapping_type
methods.description: Maps VRB to PRB mapping types to FAPI enumeration.

methods.name: convert_pdsch_mac_to_fapi
methods.description: Main function to convert various MAC PDSCH configurations into FAPI PDU builder commands, supporting multiple input types.
